description: Small machine-checkable bootstrap suite for FORGE cognition evolution. Mutation design sees training summaries only; holdout task details are withheld from the mutation prompt.

tasks.prompt: Calculate 17 * 23. Return the exact integer only.
In JavaScript, what does [1,2,3].map(x => x * 2).join('-') return? Return only the resulting string.
Name the three additive RGB primary colors in this exact format: color, color, color. No other text.
All ravens are birds. No birds are mammals. Can any raven be a mammal? Start with Yes or No, then give one short sentence of reasoning.
Calculate 29 * 37. Return the exact integer only.
In JavaScript, what does ['a','b'].reverse().join('') return? Return only the resulting string.
Reply with exactly: EVIDENCE > INFERENCE > SPECULATION
Some pilots are musicians. All musicians are creative. Must some pilots be creative? Start with Yes or No, then give one short sentence of reasoning.
